Name: PinkStations Heart Farm Map
Author: PinkStations
Description:
[b][size=4]~PinkStations Heart Farm~[/size][/b]
[size=2]My pretty heart farm map. This is an open layout farm shaped like a heart with wings! It has 2 easy access spots for watering plants, 2 waterfalls, A pond for fishing, a quarry, & hardwood stumps spawn locations. It also has a 50% chance for catching mountain fish and forageables spawn![/size]

[size=2]I hope you can enjoy this map and feel free to share a screenshot of your layout! I'd love to see what you can do with it![/size]
[size=2]
[size=3]Requirements:[/size]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]Smapi[/url]﻿[/size][size=3][size=2]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3231]Farm Type Manager﻿[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4736]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets[/url]﻿

[/size]How to Install:
[size=2]~ Download and then unzip[/size]
[size=2]~[/size][/size][size=2] Put the unzipped folder into your mods folder
~ Run the game and pick the Standard Farm

[size=3]Mods used in pictures:
[size=2]~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2893756]Yri[/url]'s Project Yellog Recolors: I use the 3 modular recolor options found [/size][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799][size=3][size=2]here[/size][/size][/url]﻿ and modular town overhaul [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14765]here[/url]﻿
~ [url=https://yellog.postype.com/post/11565362]Yellog's Wood Buildings﻿[/url]﻿
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5407]Wildflower Grass Field[/url]
~ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5512]Shipping Chest[/url]﻿
[/size]
[size=2]Please let me know about any issues & enjoy :)
[/size]
[i][font=Comic Sans MS][size=2][center]This farm map is made in memory of my best friend Anastasia. I'll miss you forever my love <3.
I hope you guys can always find the time to play with your friends while they're still here.[/center][/size][/font][/i]
